errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the color of the 'Nuclear energy' slice as 'light green/aquamarine'. The actual color in the chart is cyan/light blue, which has no green component. This creates ambiguity, as the same color description ('светлозелен/аквамарин') is later used for the 'Wind' category, which has a distinctly different, light green color.

The description identifies the color for 'solid fossil fuels' as 'лилав' (purple), when the actual color is magenta. While this color is used consistently for the 'Solar' category as well, 'purple' is an inaccurate description for magenta.
